svg.title: Time per application shape
svg.desc: Median time of each application shape on PostgreSQL, pg_sift, PostgreSQL flat tables and ClickHouse.
svg.text: Real query shapes on 1.2M orders: time per shape
Median wall milliseconds of one backend on a logarithmic axis, left is faster. G1-G8 read the whole table; S1-S7 are reports of a
set of stores, shown with the smallest (10) and the largest (4,000) filter. On the right pg_sift against the fastest other system.

svg.text: Data: docs/results/analytics.json, 2026-10-22, median of 5 runs, one backend with no parallel workers, ClickHouse on one thread; the filter of
